_comment: All of Switzerland (data/regions/ch.geojson). High-speed by maxspeed (200 km/h and up outside China) and the cross-border networks.

exemptions.reason: Rhaetian Railway, Matterhorn Gotthard, Aare Seeland, zb and the other metre-gauge railways are scheduled public passenger lines. Most of their track is typed from usage=branch/main or its route relations; the remaining short pieces are mapped railway=narrow_gauge with neither usage nor a route relation of their own, which the generic narrow-gauge rule leaves as Other (type_source default; the usage=tourism pieces, e.g. the Schynige Platte rack railway, stay Other)
